overview_description.description: Empire Aviation Group (EAG) is a one-stop shop for integrated private aviation services, offering aircraft sales, aircraft management, aircraft charter, and aircraft finance and insurance. Operating an extensive fleet of business jets, Empire Aviation has more than 20 aircraft based in global locations. These include Dubai - UAE, Oman, India, Hong Kong and Nigeria. The company has a team of 150 aviation specialists and has expanded its operations across the globe with new branch openings in India, San Marino, Hong Kong and a dedicated sales office in the USA.

about_short_description.short_description: Empire Aviation Group is a one-stop shop for integrated private aviation services, offering aircraft sales, aircraft management.

product.name: Aircraft Management
product.description: Empire Aviation provides comprehensive aircraft management services, including operational and maintenance support, crew management, and cost tracking to ensure the value and performance of the aircraft.

product.name: Aircraft Charter
product.description: Empire Aviation offers private jet charter services with a diverse fleet of aircraft, catering to various travel needs and ensuring safety and comfort for passengers.

product.name: Aircraft Sales
product.description: Empire Aviation assists clients in buying and selling new and pre-owned aircraft, providing support through the entire process including technical inspections and history checks.

product.name: CAMO Services
product.description: Empire Aviation offers Continuing Airworthiness Management Organization (CAMO) services to ensure the airworthiness and safety of aircraft, including maintenance oversight and certification.
